top_story.title: Stock Futures Jump. Market Rally Gathers Pace as Earnings Season Ramps Up.
top_story.summary: Stocks looked set to rise again on Wednesday, building on gains from the previous session that were powered by a solid start to the second-quarter earnings season and cooler-than-expected inflation data.  Nasdaq futures climbed 0.3%, and S&P 500 futures rose 0.1%.  The three major indexes all closed in the green on Tuesday, with the Dow eking out a gain thanks to Goldman Sachs and JPMorgan Chase.
